caseNameFull: Tooahnippah (Goombi), Administratrix v. Hickel, Secretary of the Interior

opinions.text: ante, p. 598. Motions to substitute Julia Tooahnippah (Goombi), Administratrix, in place of James Tooahimpah Tate, deceased, former Administrator of Estate of Frankie Lee Tooahnippah, deceased, and Estate of Viola Atewoof-takewa (Tate), deceased, as a party petitioner, granted.
